scope: M4/M5 laboratory software foundation on synthetic fixtures; no identified device, real DAQ data or hardware contact

requirements.LAB-001: Profile states, source requirement, identified-status and control gates; user's equipment recorded as unidentified intake profile
requirements.LAB-002: Byte/record loss ledger and raw-hash immutability on the synthetic test format only; real decoder and golden files need the device specification and a recorded sample
requirements.LAB-003: Rollover/epoch unwrap and profile-bound channel offsets; deriving offsets from known timing fixtures is not implemented
requirements.LAB-004: Independent-trigger denominator guard with dead-time exclusion; active-area selection needs external tracks
requirements.LAB-007: Replay without hardware; control refused without identification, operator and approved limits; no control adapter exists
requirements.LAB-008: Run record with raw, profile, config, calibration and source-tree identities; conditions and masks not yet captured by the CLI
